title: Attestation is All You Need: Toward a Zero-Trust Architecture for HPC AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.32958v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents are beginning to automate data analysis, orchestration, and simulation steering in HPC environments, but they introduce a security problem that existing cluster defenses do not address: the hijacked authorized agent. An adversary can subvert an agent through prompt injection, poisoned shared data, compromised tools, or multi-agent coordination, then exfiltrate sensitive data through legitimate encrypted LLM API traffic. We propose behavioral attestation as a runtime defense for this setting. Our system, AEGIS, compiles task-derived behavioral constraints, monitors agent actions with ebpf-based syscall interception, verifies evidence against constraint profiles, correlates behavior across agents, and triggers slurm-level containment. translated_title: 证明即所需：面向HPC AI智能体的零信任架构
translated_abstract: AI智能体开始在高性能计算（HPC）环境中实现数据分析、编排和仿真引导的自动化，但它们引入了一个现有集群防御机制无法解决的安全问题：被劫持的授权智能体。攻击者可以通过提示注入、投毒的共享数据、被攻陷的工具或跨智能体协同来破坏智能体，随后通过合法的加密LLM API流量外泄敏感数据。我们提出行为证明作为针对该场景的运行时防御手段。我们的系统AEGIS编译源自任务的行为约束，利用基于eBPF的系统调用拦截来监控智能体行为，将证据与约束配置文件进行核验，跨智能体关联行为，并触发Slurm级别的遏制措施。在实际证明路径上，AEGIS以1秒的检测间隔实现了亚秒级的中位检测延迟和较低的验证器开销，成功检测出全部四类已实现的攻击。受控实验表
tldr: 提出AEGIS系统，通过编译任务行为约束、基于eBPF的系统调用监控、跨智能体行为关联以及Slurm级遏制，实现了针对HPC环境中被劫持授权AI智能体的运行时零信任行为证明防御。
en_tdlr: AEGIS delivers a runtime zero-trust behavioral attestation defense against hijacked authorized AI agents in HPC environments by compiling task-derived behavioral constraints, monitoring agent actions via eBPF-based syscall interception, correlating cross-agent behavior, and triggering Slurm-level containment.
